title: November / December program spread

location.series: COLLINS / San Francisco Symphony case study
location.extent: Whole published artwork or representative frame of complete local clip

slide_intent: Separate navigation, titles and descriptive copy because a dense schedule must support quick scanning and close reading.
strategic_value: Large month numerals and compact columns can carry Symphony character without sacrificing program detail.
demonstration: A two-page program spread uses three columns per page, oversized 11 and 12 numerals, condensed titles and smaller body copy.
practical_value: Assign distinct typographic roles to months, dates, program names and descriptions.

content_islands.name: Month markers
content_islands.spec: Keep the large 11 at upper left and 12 on the right page as navigation landmarks.

content_islands.name: Program columns
content_islands.spec: Preserve six columns of dates, headlines, descriptions and performer details.

content_islands.name: Folio
content_islands.spec: Retain the November/December labels and printed pages 28–29 at the foot.
